neighbours.label: Arabic verb-first (VSO) clauses: the noun phrase right after a clause-initial verb, usually its subject; quiet when the subject comes before the verb
neighbours.notes: Near misses are the same eight sentences reordered subject-first (SVO), so only word order changes. Top corpus examples are mostly Arabic VSO subjects (e.g. 'دعت منظمة العفو الدولية', 'ذكرت وكالة انترفاكس الروسية'), plus one German verb-before-subject clause. In probing, the peak sometimes landed on the object right after the subject ('المعرض الفني').
